description: Fetch most recent posts of an account: caption, media type, likes, comments, timestamp, shortcode, permalink, and whether it is pinned, has comments turned off or is liked by you. Pinned posts first, then newest first. Pages internally; returns nextCursor when more remain.

cursor.description: Resume token from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for newest.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

name: ig_fetch_posts
title: Instagram fetch posts
